records.name: Roadside Troll Attack
records.summary: A Selwick & Company wagon carrying ordinary commercial cargo is attacked by a troll on the PCs' approach to Tallowmere. Protecting the crew or recovering the consignment can earn a modest reward and a written introduction to Meret Sorn.

records.name: Warehouse Guild Introduction
records.summary: A signed recommendation from Tavren Selwick can provide the PCs a first commercial meeting with Meret Sorn. It grants credibility, not guild membership or universal trust.
